notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three other Islands.
You control at least two creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary.
Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, triggering Tatyova twice and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve both Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw two cards and gain two life.
Repeat.
